title: Export tremolo picking and preserve supported stroke variants
scope: Retain authored tremolo subdivision/marks through parsing, public edits and GP8 output.
acceptance: Reproduce the missing tremolo in testdata/gp4/Effects.gp4 and cover supported 8th/16th/32nd subdivisions.
Inventory extended marks/styles in the pinned model and prove GP source/target support before promising each variant.
Strict export accepts supported variants and reports unsupported styles individually rather than dropping all tremolo picking.
exclusions: GP3 has no tremolo-picking source record.
AlphaTab model marks 0, 4, and 5 and the BuzzRoll style have no Guitar Pro GPIF source/target representation in the pinned importer and writer.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
Reproduced at tracks[0].staves[0].bars[1].voices[0].beats[0].tremoloPicking. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.
Covers GP4 binary marks, GP7 GPIF subdivisions, beat-wide authority, legacy fallback, exact GP8 wire, reimport, validation, and strict loss policy.
Uses isolated pinned-consumer facts for the GP4 source, Go GP8 output, and AlphaTab model mark/style bounds.
Pinned Guitar Pro writer emits only default-style marks 1, 2, and 3 as 1/2, 1/4, and 1/8.

resolution: Promoted tremolo picking to a beat-wide authority, corrected binary mark ordering, preserved the legacy note-local fallback with a complete-duration conflict report, and emitted supported plain subdivisions in GP8. Dotted, double-dotted, tupletted, otherwise unsupported rates, and notation styles now have explicit target-loss reports.
